verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud SLO explicitly supports defining SLIs/SLOs with acceptable service levels and reacting when service degrades, and Grafana Alerting supports multi-source alert rules; together these enable burn-rate style alerting on error budgets. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions 'error budget' or 'burn-rate' terminology/configuration, and SLO appears to be a Cloud-only feature rather than core OSS Grafana. Missing for 10: explicit error-budget/burn-rate alert documentation, confirmation of OSS availability vs Cloud-only, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the SLO feature.
